title: Shared library scanning
changes: Shared-folder PBP games are identified as PlayStation or PSP from their format, so PSP games no longer require a PlayStation BIOS.
The shared managed folder is scanned by default with the config and ROM mounts.

title: PlayStation loading placement
changes: PlayStation loading, progress and starting messages appear in the game picture area, including before the core starts.

title: PlayStation touch controls
changes: PlayStation shows both DualShock sticks from the start, without controller pop-in when a game switches modes.
The PlayStation audio activation prompt appears over the game picture.

title: PlayStation portrait centering
changes: PlayStation uses an independent default portrait picture area above the standard controls. Controller layout changes leave picture placement unchanged; desktop stays centered.

title: PlayStation portrait layout
changes: The PlayStation game view sits near the top in portrait, keeping its native size and controller layout.

title: Simpler server storage
changes: Server deployments now use one configuration folder and one game folder. Existing game URLs, saves and settings are preserved.

title: GameCube performance readout is optional
changes: The *GameCube performance readout* now starts off by default. Enable it in Settings > Core Settings; your saved choice is preserved.

title: Mobile play and a refreshed library
changes: *PSP support*: available by default, with streaming for large games. HTTPS and WebGL2 are required.
A compact *mobile library* with search, touch controls and game details. Install as a web app for a full-screen experience.
A centered app icon, a clearer *Recently Played* history icon and distinct console artwork on mobile and desktop.
Desktop console artwork leaves the system name to the carousel, keeping category labels clear and readable.
*Recently Played restores automatically* when the library opens, including your connected account's cached and cloud history.
Installed web apps use the full display height for the library and games, with your saved touch-button positions preserved.
Installed iPhone/iPad apps request an opaque black system status bar to reduce top-edge fading. Games fill the available display and saved controls remain intact.
*Nextcloud saves* with optional automatic sign-in when enabled. Recently Played and controller layouts sync when connected.
An integrated folder scanner and feed builder, with startup scans and scheduled refreshes when enabled.
*PlayStation discs and larger 3DS ROMs stream during play* and require an internet connection.
*3DS shaders cache as they are created.* New shaders can briefly hitch, especially when many appear at once on mobile.
